step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows live video broadcast workflows on AWS. A camera feed enters CloudPort Live (Kubernetes/EKS). S3 stores graphics and VOD assets, processed by Asset Processing (EC2). Automation (EC2) schedules the broadcast into Playout (EC2), which receives the feed from CloudPort Live and graphics from Asset Processing. Playout sends the output to a primary Hitless Switcher (EC2), which feeds a redundant Hitless Switcher (EC2) across AZs for high availability. From there, output flows via Direct Connect to the satellite/head-end distribution.
